entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: A cloud-native platform for public and academic libraries to catalogue physical and digital items, manage circulation, and provide self-service portals, enforcing strict EU-only data residency.

entities.name: Library Member (Patron)
entities.description: End-user who searches for items, manages loans, and uses self-service portals.

entities.name: Librarian / Staff
entities.description: Staff member who manages circulation, catalogs items, and assists patrons.

entities.name: Library Administrator
entities.description: Administrator who configures the system, manages users, and oversees system operations.

entities.name: Anycast CDN / DDoS Protection Service (EU-PoPs)
entities.description: Edge service providing DDoS protection and routing traffic via EU points of presence.

entities.name: EU Cloud Infrastructure (AWS/Azure EU Region)
entities.description: Hosting environment that persists data and anchors all hosting within certified EU regions.

entities.name: EU Identity Provider (IdP)
entities.description: Provides authentication services via OIDC/OAuth2 with MFA for users and administrators.

entities.name: EU Compliance & Audit Logging Service
entities.description: Receives exported audit events for compliance tracking.

entities.name: EU Monitoring & APM Provider
entities.description: Receives operational telemetry to meet performance and latency requirements.

entities.name: Third-Party Digital Content Providers (OverDrive/Libby)
entities.description: Provides digital assets and content syncing for circulation.

entities.name: External Notification Service
entities.description: Dispatches alerts and notifications via SMTP or HTTPS API.

entities.name: EU Secondary Region Backup Target
entities.description: Target for replicated backups within EU regions.

entities.name: API Gateway / BFF
entities.description: Handles edge routing, TLS termination, and rate limiting.

entities.name: Patron Portal
entities.description: Self-service portal for library members to search and manage loans.

entities.name: Staff Circulation App
entities.description: Application for staff to manage circulation and assist patrons.

entities.name: Admin Console
entities.description: Console for administrators to configure system operations.

entities.name: Search & Catalog Service
entities.description: Provides sub-800ms search performance and catalog management.

entities.name: Circulation & Core Engine
entities.description: Core business logic engine for managing circulation and library workflows.

entities.name: Primary Database
entities.description: Persists application data with AES-256 encryption at rest.

entities.name: Notification Worker
entities.description: Dispatches notifications asynchronously.

entities.name: Digital Content Sync Worker
entities.description: Syncs digital content from third-party providers asynchronously.

interfaces.description: Routes traffic to the core system
Routes traffic to the API Gateway
Sends API requests and WebSocket messages
Reads and writes core data securely

naming_conventions: External systems and services should specify their regional scope or compliance boundary (e.g., 'EU').
Users and roles are categorized clearly as persons with descriptive functional titles.
Services are named '<Domain> Service' or '<Domain> & Core Engine'.
Workers and asynchronous processors are named '<Domain> Worker'.
